summary: Add explicit owner handoff for local canonical leases (NP-052)

delivery.outcome: Provide explicit authenticated local owner handoff with exact CAS/state binding, atomic recovery and replay-safe monotonic lease issuance.
nonGoals: No idle algorithm or runtime policy change
No foreign checkout cleanup or consumer adoption

architecture.decision: Reuse the registered local controller NoFollow/atomic primitives. A protected outer invoker must authenticate explicit old-owner consent; neither labels nor FD JSON authenticate. Bind its verifier evidence, complete canonical Git/content/index/intent snapshot and exact lease CAS, archive and journal before one bounded monotonic successor, and reauthenticate exact replay without renewing.
interfaceChanges: Explicit old-owner handoff request and receipt
dataChanges: Atomic handoff archive and journal bound to old/new lease state
architecture.rollback: Protected revert preserving immutable journals, archived original state and prior lease receipts.

validation.evidence: Real Git/CAS/owner/context handoff and atomic archive regressions.
Wrong owner, stale state, symlink, frozen, expiry-without-consent and replay negatives fail closed.
Managed governance, package/release projections and qualified focused tests pass; protected CI and independent review remain required.
